gap_report_metadata.requirement_title: Foot Locker Website Navigation, Product Discovery, and Global UI Validation

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC-1: Homepage & Global Header Loading - The Foot Locker homepage must load successfully with: The page title containing "Foot Locker". The page body rendered and visible. The global header visible. The primary navigation items visible: Men's, Women's, Kids', Sale, Releases
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-002: Global nav bar is visible

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC-2: Primary Category Navigation - When the user clicks the following primary navigation items: Men's, Women's, Kids', The browser must navigate away from the homepage to the corresponding category landing page.
AC-3: Logo Navigation & Site Return - When the user clicks the Foot Locker logo from any page, the user must be navigated back to the Foot Locker homepage: https://www.footlocker.com/
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-009: Logo click returns to homepage

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC-4: Cart Icon Navigation - When the user clicks the Cart icon in the global header, the browser must navigate to the cart page: /cart
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-010: Cart icon navigates to cart page

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC-5: Primary Navigation Hover & Mega-Menu - When the user hovers over Men's in the primary navigation: The Men's mega-menu must open. The mega-menu must display a Shoes sub-category link. The Shoes link must contain a valid href.
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-008: Mega-menu sub-links render for Men's

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC-6: Primary Navigation Direct Links — Releases & Sale - When the user clicks Releases: The browser must navigate to /release-calendar. The Release Calendar content must be displayed. When the user clicks Sale: The browser must navigate to /category/sale.html. Sale-related content must be displayed.
AC-7: Category Navigation Status - Direct navigation to the following primary category pages must return a successful, non-error HTTP response: Men's, Women's, Kids', Sale, Releases
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-011: No broken links across primary nav

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC-8: Category Page Results & Product Tile Pricing - When the user navigates to a category page, for example: /category/mens/shoes.html The page must: Display a results-count heading matching "Showing {N} results". Display a product grid. Each visible product tile must contain: A non-empty product title. A visible price. The price must be formatted as $X.XX.
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-012: Product grid renders on category page
TC-013: Product tile shows name and valid price

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC-9: Sale Page Dual Pricing - When the user navigates to the Sale page and locates product tiles: Product tiles must display an original price. Product tiles must display a discounted price. Both price values must be visible and non-empty.
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-014: Sale page shows discounted pricing

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC-10: Hero / Promo Banner Verification - The Foot Locker homepage hero/promo banner must: Be visible. Display a non-empty heading. Contain a call-to-action link. The call-to-action link must have a valid href.
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-015: Homepage hero banner has content and CTA

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC-11: Brand Page Display & Product Links - When the user navigates to a dedicated brand page, for example: /category/brands/nike.html The page must: Load successfully. Display brand-related text/content. Contain at least one related product link. The product link must have a valid href.
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-016: Brand page shows brand-specific content (Nike)

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC-12: Header Store Locator & Footer Verification - The global header must display "Find a Store". After scrolling to the footer: The footer must be visible. The footer must contain at least one link. The footer must contain a Privacy-related link. The Privacy-related link must have a valid href.
